# CommandMenu
Atlas Command Menu — a search field over a grouped list of commands, shown on an overlay surface.

USE WHEN
· The user needs to jump to a page or run an action by typing (opened with Cmd or Ctrl + K).
DON'T USE WHEN
· Filtering a page's own content (use the search and filter pattern).
· A short fixed list of actions fits in a Dropdown Menu.
HOW TO USE
· Size md is 500 wide, lg is 600, like Dialog.
· State default lists the results, empty shows no matches, loading shows a Spinner.
· The Results slot takes Dropdown Menu Label and Dropdown Menu Item rows; the highlighted row uses Item State focus.
